intent: A multi-stage standing combat combo with alternating unilateral attacks, followed by a two-arm overhead re-chamber, a broad bilateral finishing release, and recovery to the initial guard.

phases.label: first broad attack arc → follow-through / settle

keyPoses.role: recovered guard, visually close to the initial stance

weightTransfer: The pelvis/COM proxy initially travels backward, with the backward excursion peaking around f42. It then drives strongly forward-left through approximately f75–f80, lowers to its minimum height around f86, and returns close to its starting pelvis position by f109. Support-foot identity is not asserted because the approved evidence is not strong enough.
bodyMechanics: The first major action is not a simultaneous whole-body release: the left arm initiates around f17–f21; the trunk, hips, and right shoulder build rotation around f28–f30; then the right distal arm releases strongly around f32–f34. In the final action, both arms gather and cross overhead by f71, then open into the broad two-arm finishing extension around f80 before recovering to guard.

recommended: timing and sequencing of a multi-stage standing combat combo
alternating unilateral wind-up → attack → follow-through mechanics
transition from a two-arm overhead re-chamber into a broad bilateral finishing release
whole-body recovery from an extended finish back into guard
notRecommendedAsPrimary: exact weapon path, contact timing, or hit-frame placement
exact weapon type, grip, or hand-to-weapon relationship
